hints.title: Sorted Array Last Occurrence Search
hints.text: Finding the last index of a target value within a sorted list requires locating the highest index matching target or returning minus one.

hints.title: Bisection Search for Upper Bound
hints.text: Use binary search across sorted elements. When mid equals target, record mid and continue searching rightward (low = mid + 1) to find the maximum index.

hints.title: Upper Bound Blueprint
hints.text: let l = 0, r = this.length - 1, ans = -1. While (l <= r) { const mid = (l + r) >> 1; if (this[mid] === target) { ans = mid; l = mid + 1; } else if (this[mid] < target) { l = mid + 1; } else { r = mid - 1; } } Return ans.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Halves the search space at each comparison step.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Array.prototype.lastIndexOf takes linear O(N) time scanning elements sequentially.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search exploits sorted array order for logarithmic runtime.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Logarithmic O(log N) runtime using binary search.

solutions.approach: Binary Search for Rightmost Target Index
